# Native O3 eta-core moment functionals: accepted conditional local DATA

This publication records local leading-order moment-function coefficient enclosures and a typed, uninstantiated n1 m15 affine operator.

Display endpoints prefixed ~ are text approximations. Exact directed endpoint strings and MPF tuples remain authoritative in the lossless result; displayed approximations are not certified interval endpoints.

Scope: native rho in [0,4], eta in [-1,1], ordinary Z at fixed rho. The old analytic extent rho=4.1 is not spliced into this native core, and no tau field is introduced.

Native order: m11 = Mz; m12 = Mtheta; m13 = Mp; m14 = Mtheta_z; m15 = Mz_theta. P1 is not m15. Source-original R moments are not Eulerian physical-volume or Eulerian L2-volume moments.

Phi1 and DU1 are first Picard-iterate approximations to the leading n0 fields, with certified posteriori errors; the subscript 1 here is not temporal n1. The actual leading Phi/U functions remain only enclosed DATA. The leading m13 is epsilon*S*ratio^2*integral(Phi^2), hence P0(R)-P0(axis) under the exact centrifugal balance; it is P0, not P1.

The exact old-core-to-eta function binder is still missing; no n1 Uz1/P1/F1/N1p/N1z values are inferred.

Actual saved tables: 80 leading moment rows and 64 affine-basis rows. Display counts are projections only; execution counts remain in the raw result.
